anti_elite.description: Hostility towards elites, politicians, and the governing class.
strong_phrases: people we elect as mps
mps lose touch
mps keep promises
politicians are corrupt
ordinary people ignored by government
exclude_phrases: change or keep the voting system
now that scotland has its own parliament

inequality.description: Grievance about unfairness, unequal treatment, and rich-poor divides.
phrases: redistribute income from the better off
big business benefits owners at the expense of workers
ordinary people do not get their fair share

authoritarianism.description: Preference for obedience, discipline, punishment, and strong authority.

immigration.description: Attitudes towards immigrants, migrants, asylum, and national exclusion.
strong_phrases: illegal immigrants
number of immigrants to britain
migrants come to britain from other countries
immigration numbers
asylum seekers should stay
exclude illegal immigrants

welfare.description: Attitudes about social security, deservingness, and benefit conditionality.

social security do not deserve help
government should spend more money on welfare

benefits for unemployed people

trust.description: Trust or distrust in government, parliament, politicians, and institutions.

strong_phrases: undermines britain's distinctive identity
